notes.title: 1.15 More fixes for Upgrades Panel disappearing bug.
notes.content: [p]Apologies to anyone that was affected by upgrades/UI disappearing when scrolling the upgrade panel in chapter 2/4. [/p][p][/p][p]This patch has a few more fixes that should prevent the problem from occurring. If not, please let me know! [/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Adam[/p]

notes.title: 1.14 Fix for disappearing upgrades and small balance changes
notes.content: [p]WHAT'S NEW??[/p][p][/p][h3]BUG FIX[/h3][list][*][p]Made a few changes to prevent upgrades from disappearing in chapter 2/4. I wasn't able to reproduce this one but I am confident that it is resolved. Please let me know if it's still happening. [/p][/*][/list][h3]BALANCE[/h3][list][*][p]'Motive', 'Fernand the Userper' and 'Villefort the coward' upgrades: Reduced the maximum level cap and increased the strength of each level. [/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the base iron costs for 'Learning Mindset', 'Brooding' and 'Axes Akimbo' upgrades. [/p][/*][*][p]Reduced cost scaling for 'Self-loading Musket'.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing!! And a huge thank you to everyone who sent in bug reports!![/p][p][/p][p]-Adam[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 1.13 Bug fix and balance patch
notes.content: [p]WHAT's NEW??[/p][p][/p][h3]BUG FIXES[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that could cause upgrades to disappear in chapter 2 and 4.[/p][/*][*][p]Made changes to stop clicks going through windows [/p][/*][*][p]'Depth of character' personality trait no longer resets itself.[/p][/*][*][p]Made a fix to stop musket balls hanging around. (I had trouble reproducing this one. lmk if it's still happening)[/p][/*][*][p]Made the options menu available during Chapter 3. [/p][/*][*][p]Removed the 'heavy shot' skill that shouldn't have been appearing.[/p][/*][*][p]'Weak Points' skill no longer upgrades twice. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 'return to cell' in chapter 4.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the achievement for escaping was only granted after finished chapter 3. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a text bug on the mirror and made additional mirror VFX visible.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]BALANCE[/h3][list][*][p]Showmanship now affects battle-axe rotation speed as described. [/p][/*][*][p]Lowered the cost of some skills later in chapter 2, lowered the cost of all skills in chapter 4.[/p][/*][*][p]Raised 'Mouse Empathy' cap to 16 from 10. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Massive thanks to everyone who reported issues! I appreciate it a lot. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing!![/p][p][/p][p]-Adam[/p]

notes.title: Demo update 0.33
notes.content:
[h3]WHAT'S NEW IN THE DEMO?[/h3]

- Improved scaling for widescreen displays.
- Improved hitboxes for buttons in chapter 1. 
- Added some new sound effects for buttons. 
- Added animation for when out of iron in chapter 2. 
- Improved frame rates / performance in chapter 2.

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]

- Fixed a bug that caused Iron to collect twice.
- Fixed a bug where Abbe Faria would say Edmond's line in chapter 2. 
- Fixed a bug where progress wouldn't load properly in chapter 1.
- Fixed a couple of issues with the options menu displaying properly. 
- Fixed a bug where the musket would show lvl 2/1. 
- Fixed a bug where chapter 1 ability unlock sound + effect would keep activating. 


Thanks so much for playing the demo!! 

Special thanks to everyone who reported bugs and sent in feedback! I really appreciate it.

Cheers,
Adam
